business_problem: The company was faced with the challenge of upgrading its data platform, based on legacy solutions, hosted in a data center in Hortolândia, a city in the countryside of the state of São Paulo—which also generated high costs.
solution_summary: The company was faced with the challenge of upgrading its data platform, based on legacy solutions, hosted in a data center in Hortolândia, a city in the countryside of the state of São Paulo—which also generated high costs. Fast Shop required an upgrade of its data platform in order to improve decision making and create the foundations for the adoption of AI. Fast Shop performed an assessment in partnership with UPBI and decided to migrate its data platform to Microsoft Azure, thus consolidating information, enhancing governance, and improving the strategic decision process. Fast Shop created a robust data environment with Microsoft and laid the foundations for the development of AI solutions. They created a self-service culture of access to data, eliminated delays, reduced costs, and increased leadership satisfaction with data while providing more agility in reporting.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and transforms large-scale data for analytics, machine learning, and operational insights.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Factory
solution_components.role: Moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the cloud analytics environment.

solution_components.name: Azure Analysis Services
solution_components.role: Hosts governed semantic models that power enterprise reporting and analysis.

solution_components.name: Azure Storage
solution_components.role: Stores durable cloud data used by applications and analytics workflows.

solution_components.name: Event Hubs
solution_components.role: Ingests streaming events for downstream processing and analytics.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

data_flow: Data moves from Azure Data Factory and connected sources into Azure analytics services and Azure Databricks, where it is transformed, modeled, and stored for governed access before being served to business users through Power BI dashboards.
business_outcome: Fast Shop is an example of how companies may benefit from the organization of their available data to achieve digital transformation, using Microsoft Azure solutions to get ready for the next step towards AI.
